As the weather cools and autumn outdoor activity season begins, I usually adjust my everyday carry list to fit my lifestyle. If you're looking for something more rugged and durable for hiking and water activities that can also serve as your daily wallet, the Pelican MagSafe wallet and card case is my top pick.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers brings you the latest news from the MagSafe and wireless charging industry to help you get the most out of your wireless charging-supported Apple devices.

Best for outdoor activities

The Pelican wallet has an IPX4 water resistance rating, meaning your credit cards and cash won't get wet if it gets splashed on a hike or by the lake. Once snapped shut, it stays sealed—for example, in the fall I go to several Falcons games, and even while watching football, I like knowing everything is securely tucked away. That alone makes it a practical choice for autumn outdoor activities, since the weather can change quickly. It's less like a wallet and more like a small hard-shell protective case clipped to the back of your iPhone.

Most MagSafe wallets are only designed to hold a few cards with no other functionality. Pelican's design gives you more flexibility—you can easily fit your ID and credit cards, with room for a few folded bills and a small key. If you want to travel light on a hike, this wallet covers the basics without needing to carry an extra bag.

Although the Pelican wallet is primarily designed for outdoor use, it also works great as an everyday carry. It attaches firmly to the back of your iPhone with strong magnets, and the latching design keeps things from falling out. Compared with other less durable MagSafe wallets, this one sacrifices a bit of slimness in exchange for more reliable protection. If you want a minimalist, lightweight wallet in the summer, I probably wouldn't choose it, but for hiking, going to a football game, or any outdoor activity where the weather might change, it's a perfect match. It's also a great MagSafe wallet choice for kids who just got their first iPhone. My older son has been using his for several years now.

Pelican MagSafe Wallet Summary

The Pelican MagSafe wallet is designed for people who value durability, need to protect their everyday carry from weather and water, can handle multi-stop trips or a full day out, and want something that attaches securely. If you want a MagSafe wallet that can withstand drops while still performing well for daily use, this is the one for you.

You can purchase the Pelican MagSafe wallet directly from Amazon or the Pelican website.
